Become a Partner on Tistahal platform

Join Tistahal platform, Emirates NBD’s exclusive rewards platform for Emirati debit cardholders, and connect your brand exclusively with Emirati customers across the UAE.

As a Tistahal partner, you’ll gain a marketing exposure designed to drive visibility and engagement for your brand. You’ll also benefit from Emirates NBD’s trusted brand association, with promotions featured across our digital channels and customer touchpoints.

Why partner with us:

Reach a growing base of Emirati customers across the UAE

Drive measurable sales through targeted offers

Enhance your brand visibility with Emirates NBD co-marketing
